Master '''Admira''' is a Tairen merchant.

==Appearance==
Master Admira is a stocky man with a dark, square face.{{ref/book|9|32}}

==Activities==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] is at [[The Golden Wheel]] in [[Far Madding]], he overhears a trader trying to convince Master Admira to continue to bring his custom to the city.{{ref/book|9|32}}
